name: Bard Portal Master
body:
Portals are the business of a portal master; opening doorways, barring gates, locating hidden portals, and even conjuring entryways into the multiverse.

Class skills

A portal master adds Disable Device to his list of class skills.

This alters the bard’s class skills.

Easy access (Su)

At 1st level, as a standard action, a portal master can touch a door, window, or other portal to increase or decrease the DC of any check to unlock or force open the portal by an amount equal to 1/2 his portal master level. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A portal master can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + 1/2 his portal master level.

This replaces distraction and inspire courage.

Tools of the trade (Su)

At 1st level, a portal master can expend one use of bardic performance to conjure a set of thieves’ tools. These tools persist until they leave the portal master’s possession, at which time they disappear. A portal master also adds the following list of bonus spells to his list of spells known and do not count against his total allotment of known spells. open/close (cantrip), hold portal (1st), knock (2nd), warp wood (3rd), dimension door (4th), passwall (5th), phase door (6th)

The portal master can cast each of these spells once per day as a spell-like ability when he attains the specified level.

At 6th level, when a portal master conjures a set of thieves’ tools using his bardic performance, they are considered masterwork. At 18th level, once per day as a move action, a portal master can touch a door, window, or other portal and instantly pass through it to the other side of the portal.

This ability replaces fascinate, suggestion, mass suggestion, and the two extra uses of bardic performance gained at 6th and 18th levels.

Versatile performance (Ex)

At 2nd level, a portal master gains mime (Acrobatics, Disable Device) as an additional type of Perform with its associated skills.

This alters versatile performance.

Sharp sighted (Ex)

Portal masters develop keen powers of observation from hours spent scrutinizing minute details while seeking out secret doors.

At 2nd level, a portal master gains a competence bonus on all Perception checks equal to 1 + half his bard level. In addition, the portal master’s miss chance due to any form of concealment is reduced by 5% at 2nd level, and 10% at 10th level.

This replaces well-versed.
